media.title: ભારેખમ ચહેરે તપાસતા દાક્તર
media.description: ઢોરના દાક્તર આંગણામાં ઘૂંટણિયે બેસીને પડેલા ગોરિયાને તપાસે છે, પાસે એમની ખૂલી પેટી પડી છે, અને ગોલુ, દગડુ ને શાંતા એમનો ભારેખમ ચહેરો જોઈ રહ્યાં છે.
media.teaching_notes: આ ચિત્ર પર બે જ સવાલ પૂછો — દાક્તરનો ચહેરો કેમ ભારેખમ છે ? ઘરનાં ત્રણેયની આંખમાં શું દેખાય છે ? આગળ શું થાય છે એ અહીં જરાય ન કહો; ''હવે શું થશે ?'' એ સવાલ પર જ વર્ગને અટકાવો. મોડું કેમ થયું એ પૂછાય, પણ ઘરનાં માણસોને બેદરકાર કહેવાનું ટાળો — એમણે પહેલાં પોતાના ઉપાય કર્યા હતા.

notes: Reuse is DORMANT in this pack. No Gujarati frame pool, no v1 Gujarati plan corpus, no rendered frame library and no shipped [reused frame: …] stamp exists, so step 1 does nothing and does it explicitly: every scene carries image_url "" plus a real authored self-contained generation_prompt, reused is 0, authored equals scenes, rejected is []. No Hindi or CBSE frame was borrowed and no scoring machinery was imported; no _collage.json was authored.

scenes = 3, counted the way agents/09_media_planning.md defines it — off 05_with_content.json, the topics whose available_content_types carry "image": M1.S1.T1, M2.S2.T4 and M3.S4.T6. FLAG FOR AGENT 13: the chapter has SEVEN reading-scene topics, so scenes (3) does not equal the topic count (7). This is not a rounding and it was not decided here — Agent 5 recorded primary_content_type null and available_content_types [] for M1.S1.T2, M2.S2.T3, M2.S3.T5 and M3.S5.T7, following Agent 2's mapping of the chapter's three printed colour illustrations. 05_with_content.json is another agent's file and is read-only here, so no media node was written for a topic that declares no image: a media node on a topic whose available_content_types is [] would be a contract inconsistency at assembly (Agents 14/15). If the one-image-per-reading-scene count is to be met at seven, the fix belongs upstream in Agent 5's content-type fields and then here, not in this file alone.

The three text-only topics do each hold a depictable moment (દફતરનો ઘા કરીને ગોરિયા પાસે પહોંચતો ગોલુ; સૂમસામ ઘર અને આકળ-વિકળ ચંદેરી; ગોળીનો ભૂક્કો ભેળવેલું બાટલીનું પાણી; માના આંચળે વળગેલો ગોરિયો), so the shortfall is a content-type gap, not a 'nothing depictable' finding. Nothing was invented to fill it.

Concept-scoped ids, chapter-continuous concept numbering: M1.S1.T1.C1.IMG1, M2.S2.T4.C7.IMG1, M3.S4.T6.C10.IMG1. For the two-concept topics the frame was hung on the concept it actually depicts — C1 (the household itself) for M1.S1.T1 and C10 (the night work with કોથળા, બાલદી અને લોટો) for M3.S4.T6. No topic-scoped id, no restarted concept number, one image per topic, no topic with two images.

PAGE RENDERS WERE OPENED, and why. 00_chapter_normalized.md carries no [[ચિત્ર: …]] markers, and Agent 5's note explicitly hands this gap to Agent 9. _renders/page-1.png, page-2.png and page-3.png were read to confirm that three colour illustrations do sit inside the reading text on printed folios 63, 64 and 65, that they land on M1.S1.T1, M2.S2.T4 and M3.S4.T6 exactly as Agent 2 reasoned, and to fix one consistent likeness for the four recurring figures across the chapter's frames. No text was re-transcribed from the renders; 00_chapter_normalized.md remains the source of truth for every Gujarati string in this file.

Likeness is held constant by REPEATING the same appearance sentences in each prompt, never by referring back: ગોલુ (about eleven, short black hair, plain yellow half-sleeved shirt, blue trousers, barefoot), દગડુ (lean, moustached, dark indigo turban wound low, white long-sleeved village shirt, white dhoti, barefoot), શાંતા (green blouse, deep purple ankle-length skirt, red odhani drawn over her head, silver anklets, barefoot), ચંદેરી (reddish-brown cow with a soft hump, yellow rope halter) and ગોરિયો (her small reddish-brown calf). Each of these is what the printed illustrations show; none is a costume the text does not place in the scene. No prompt names the chapter, a topic, a previous image or 'the same character as before'.

Setting anchoring, and the fidelity limit. The chapter prints no place name, so the yard was built from the chapter's own printed illustration and the objects the text itself names — કંતાનના કોથળા, પાણીની બાલદી, લોટો, ચોકડીનું આંગણું, પલંગ/ખાટલો, ઘાસનો પૂળો, ચંદેરી અને ગોરિયો — rather than from a slice of Gujarat the text does not choose. That is what stops the frame reading as generic-Indian: the unplastered brick wall with its green painted base band, the thick thatch on wooden posts, the woven-rope cot in the open yard, the halter and the fodder bundle. The household is named on the page as આહીર, a pastoral community, and is drawn as the page draws it — dress follows the scene, and no community's costume was bolted on for colour.

M2.S2.T4's frame shows the calf still down and the doctor's face still grave; its narrator bar carries the doctor's own unanswered sentence, and its negative_prompt refuses a healthy calf, sunrise light, wet sacks and any sign of recovery. Nothing in the earlier frame or its title, description or teaching_notes names the outcome.

varta avoid-gate 2 (a tacked-on બોધ) is enforced at the climax frame: M3.S4.T6 shows the act and nothing else, its narrator bar is ગોલુ's own printed sentence, its teaching_notes stop at his stated reason, and its negative_prompt refuses a moral caption or lesson banner inside the frame. The chapter's closing open question (દાક્તરની ગોળી કે ગોલુના ભીના કોથળા) is neither depicted nor resolved anywhere in this file.

Narrator bars carry exactly three Gujarati strings, each transcribed from 00_chapter_normalized.md and each a complete printed sentence, with the printed space before the question mark preserved: 'ચંદેરીએ ખાઈ લીધું ? ગોરિયાએ ધાવી લીધું ?' (M1.S1.T1), 'આજની રાત આ મૂંગા ઢોર માટે ભારે છે.' (M2.S2.T4) and 'એટલે આમ કોથળા ભીના કરું છું.' (M3.S4.T6). No transliteration, no Devanagari, no Roman lettering, no digit in any display text; every prompt also forbids all other lettering in the frame.
